description: Partial upsert one menu item: send only the fields to change; every omitted field (parent, sort, label, kind, ref, newTab, html/childTemplate/childShell/attrs/data) keeps its stored value, and parent: null moves it to the top level. A new id needs label, kind and ref (parent defaults to null, sort to the end) and dedupes by (menu, ref): an existing item linking the same target is reused. An existing id always updates that exact item. To remove rich keys, use put_menu_doc.
name: put_menu_item
